# Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas

`plugin.schema.json` and `mcp.schema.json` are copied unchanged from
<https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec/tree/v1.0.0/schemas/1.0.0>
(tag `v1.0.0`, commit `bd383552095128f6effe895b9257cfd580a6d179`), licensed under the Apache License 2.0 by the
Agent Plugins project. `scripts/contract-check.py` validates the checked-in
`plugins/agentfeedback/plugin.json` and `../agent-plugin-mcp.json` against
them. Replace them only with the files of a published specification release.
